This article compares the performance of Danish regions and hospitals on Indicator 3, which measures the proportion of newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients who have their TSH levels checked within a specific clinical window (60 days before to 30 days after their first diagnosis date) [^src1]. The data covers the 2022/23 reporting period and provides historical context with figures from 2021/22 and 2020/21 [^src1].

The national standard for this indicator is set at ≥95% [^src1]. However, across the 2022/23 period, not a single region or hospital managed to meet this target, with all entities marked as failing the standard ("Nej") [^src1]. The national average for Denmark stood at 77.4% [^src1]. 

Despite the universal failure to meet the 95% threshold, there is significant variation in performance among the hospitals. The highest-performing institutions were [[regionshospitalet-horsens|Regionshospitalet Horsens]] at 91.5% and [[hospitalerne-i-nordsjaelland|Hospitalerne i Nordsjælland]] at 91.1% [^src1]. Other notable high performers included [[kolding-sygehus|Kolding Sygehus]] (89.7%) and Friklinikken Region Syddanmark Grindsted (87.5%) [^src1]. Conversely, the lowest-performing hospitals were Sygehus Sønderjylland (47.4%) and Næstved (47.6%), which starkly lagged behind the national average and their peers [^src1].

Looking at trends over the three reported years, the national average saw a modest but steady improvement, rising from 75.7% in 2020/21 to 76.4% in 2021/22, and reaching 77.4% in 2022/23 [^src1]. Regional trends show varied trajectories. [[region-syddanmark|Syddanmark]] demonstrated consistent year-over-year growth, moving from 68.7% to 71.2% over the three periods [^src1]. Nordjylland experienced a significant surge in the most recent year, jumping from 69.4% in 2021/22 to 75.1% in 2022/23 [^src1]. Meanwhile, [[region-midtjylland|Midtjylland]] saw a slight decline from its peak, dropping from 82.8% in 2021/22 to 81.9% in 2022/23, though it remained well above the national average [^src1].

At the hospital level, some facilities showed dramatic improvements or volatility. Næstved improved from a low of 37.5% in 2020/21 to 50.0% in 2021/22, before slightly dipping to 47.6% in 2022/23 [^src1]. Sygehus Sønderjylland also climbed from 42.6% to 47.4% over the three years but remains a significant outlier at the bottom of the dataset [^src1]. On the other end, [[hospitalerne-i-nordsjaelland|Hospitalerne i Nordsjælland]] maintained consistently high performance, hovering around 90-92% across all three years [^src1]. [[vejle-sygehus|Vejle Sygehus]] remained relatively stable, progressing slightly from 72.3% to 74.6% [^src1].

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner resultaterne for Indikator 3 på regions- og hospitalsniveau for perioden 2022/23 og tidligere år, og viser, at ingen region eller hospital opfylder standarden på ≥95 %, dog er Hospitalerne i Nordsjælland (91,1 %) og Regionshospitalet Horsens (91,5 %) de højeste.
